name: Charles Hartley Langhorne
bio: Charles Hartley Langhorne was born at Berwick-on-Tweed in 1818 and educated at Glasgow University and at Oxford.
He was studying law when he died young, in 1845. His long, rolling lines in praise of the Greek pastoral poet Theocritus found a place in Stedman’s Victorian Anthology.

poems.title: Theocritus
